messages:
Maria: Quick recap — S3 proxy flapping earlier this morning. Pager hit multiple customer-facing endpoints for ~14m, we mitigated by rolling the proxy pool and applying a config pin. I want to lock down a postmortem, surface customer impact, and then iterate on our postmortem tooling so follow-ups don't slip. Can postmortem-bot auto-schedule and create tracked actions?

Ajay: Agree. Please capture customer-facing windows and error-rate deltas. I can pull metrics but need the canonical timeline first.

Sam: I can draft timeline. Will start with the pager logs + deploy timeline. Who owns customer outreach?

Maria: @dana.torres was on rotations for customer comms last week — Dana?

Dana: I can own outreach for affected customers. Need concise impact bullet points (duration, requests failed pct, any data loss = no). I’ll draft an email once we have the timeline.

Maria: Postmortem tooling items: 1) Ensure postmortem-bot creates a PM doc with a "customer impact" field required, 2) Auto-create action items in our action-tracker with owners + due dates, 3) Add a follow-up reminder (7d/14d/30d) automation. Thoughts?

luis.gomez: Strong +1 on required customer impact field. We keep forgetting to tag "severity" properly. For action items, can we attach the action id to the PM doc so it's easy to query?

Ajay: Yes. In addition, we should capture the oncall handoff state in the PM — who was oncall, what was the state at handoff, any partial mitigations. Handoffs are where context often gets lost.

Sam: Proposed lightweight template changes:
```
- Summary
- Timeline (with exact timestamps)
- Impact (customers, SLOs broken, external errors)
- Mitigation steps (what we tried, what worked)
- Root cause hypothesis
- Post-incident actions (owner, due date, status)
- Handoff notes (who/when/what)
- Verification plan
```
This would be the default when you run `/pm create` so we have consistency.

postmortem-bot: New PM created: /pm create --from-incident 1810023456 --template standard --owner maria.chen --due 2026-04-02 :white_check_mark:

Maria: Nice. postmortem-bot can you also create action items as tasks? Example we need: "investigate proxy health metrics retention" assigned to @luis.gomez due 2026-03-30.

postmortem-bot: Action created: TASK-4623 assigned to luis.gomez due 2026-03-30. Link: https://action-tracker.local/TASK-4623

infra-bot: Note: incident did not set `customer-impact` label. Please update the PM doc or run `/pm tag customer-impact` so dashboards pick it up.

Dana: Updated the doc with an impact section (no data loss, ~14m elevated 500s, ~2% of traffic affected — three customers with sustained errors). Draft email to customers is ready, sending after timeline confirmation.

Ajay: For follow-ups, proposal: postmortem-bot sends reminders at 7/21/45 days and posts progress to the action dashboard. Also push a short summary into the oncall-handoff digest so incoming 1st responder sees recent unresolved action items.

Maria: Love the oncall-handoff integration — when someone does `@oncall-bot handoff`, include a 1-line of open PM actions blocking. Example: "Open PM actions: TASK-4623 (luis) - investigate metrics — due 2026-03-30"

luis.gomez: I’ll take TASK-4623. Also suggestion: auto-attach a small perf profile (top 5 metrics) snapshot to the PM so reviewers don't have to re-query. Could be an S3 snapshot link.

Sam: Ops: small UX asks for postmortem-bot:
- allow `/pm create --template lightweight` for fast incidents
- support `--assign-multiple` to create parallel owners
- accept attachments when creating actions (logs, grafana snapshot)

Maria: Agree. Prioritization: 1) required customer impact field + tag enforcement, 2) auto-create task and attach task link in PM, 3) handoff digest integration, 4) reminder cadence. Can we try to ship 1 & 2 in the next sprint?

Ajay: I'll scope it with infra team. Two parts: 1) schema change in PM templates & validation, 2) webhook to action-tracker on PM creation. Estimate: 1 sprint if we don't over-engineer.

Dana: For processes, we should add a checklist in the PM for customer comms (who to cc, templates, escalation clause). Saves time and reduces back-and-forth during busy incidents.

postmortem-bot: Reminder scheduled: 7d follow-up for PM 1810023456 (Maria) — due 2026-03-25.

Maria: Assigning owners for immediate follow-ups during thread:
- Timeline draft: Sam (due 2026-03-20)
- Customer outreach draft: Dana (due 2026-03-20)
- TASK-4623 (proxy metrics): Luis (due 2026-03-30)
- Template + validation work: Ajay + infra (sprint planning)

Sam: I'll post the timeline by EOD.

luis.gomez: Starting on TASK-4623 tomorrow. Will include a snapshot link in the task.

Ajay: I'll sync with infra tomorrow to carve the work into the sprint backlog.

Maria: Thanks all. Follow-ups: once PM is published, let's have a 30m synchronous review with infra + oncall to confirm actions and timelines. I'll create calendar invite after PM is live. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Handoff digest updated. Open PM actions included in tonight's handoff.

Sam: Timeline posted: https://internal-logs.local/incident/1810023456/timeline (contains exact event stamps).

Maria: Great — closing the loop here. We now have ownership and next steps. Will review progress in the 7d reminder.

Dana: Sending customer note now.

postmortem-bot: PM 1810023456 status: in-review. Actions open: TASK-4623 (luis.gomez) / TASK-4624 (sam)

Maria: End of thread — thanks everyone.
